items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Well, we were engaged by Mr. Henri Charveau through Mr. Lattimore.

ctx.x: Well, we were engaged by Mr. Henri Charveau through Mr. Lattimore. Mr. Lattimore was a businessman, and right after World War I, there were plenty opportunities for artists abroad, you see. And Mr. Lattimore, being a very intelligent person, and a very, very good businessman, he grasped the opportunity and probably proposed the orchestra, 'cause he was more a business manager and everything. He footed all the expenses, you see.
